purpose: Stamp-reality check for the two modulator classes proposed next after line movement. Both fail closed BEFORE scoring: the timestamps required by PIT do not exist.

weather.claim_tested: Open-Meteo archived forecast, t_init <= kickoff, as an expanding-window scale modulator.
weather.stamp_columns: none -- games.csv weather fields have no observed_at/fetched_at. They are game-time finals, i.e. post-kickoff by construction. Already a permanent PIT exclusion (filter_reconciliation 2026-10-14: 'Historical pre-kickoff weather (Open-Meteo not pulled under model-run timestamps)').
weather.verdict: refused_prior. No score taken. Scoring would require starting a capture loop now so that FUTURE games have pre-kickoff fetch stamps -- those games cannot enter the frozen filter (closes 2026 W5).

injuries.claim_tested: ESPN daily injury stamps, dt <= kickoff, as a scale modulator on 2025-2026 games.
injuries.verdict: refused_prior. Not one row carries a modified timestamp; week-grain rows cannot be stamped to a day, let alone pre-kickoff. Matches the permanent PIT exclusion ('2025 injuries with no date_modified'). No score taken.

line_movement_contrast: unlike these two, the line-movement class DID find 64 stamped rows (Neon odds_line_snapshots) and was scored: refused at n_scored=64 < 150. See research/line_movement_clv_2026-10-15.json.
